title: Transfer fails after reservation
threat: An authorized transfer fails at the receipt level (recipient account missing).
legitimate_objective: Pay INV-2026-001: exactly 0.05 NEAR to the approved vendor for compute-services.
proposed_malicious_action: (Legitimate) pay 0.05 NEAR; the transfer receipt fails.

expected.contract_behavior: Callback marks FAILED and releases the reservation; the nonce stays consumed, so a retry needs a fresh, re-attested intent.
